Microsoft's XAML framework (WinUI), vendored for NovaOS
=======================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml (MIT, LICENSE),
commit 866ba81a1c7c644e41fb838c755273e8f73e3a74 (2026-10-15).
Kept so far, unchanged: dxaml/xcp/dxaml/idl (the framework's API in MIDL 3
IDL: winrt/ its Windows Runtime types, com/ its classic COM interop
interfaces), dxaml/xcp/inc/FeatureFlags.h (which IDL features are on),
dxaml/xcp/components/xamlDiagnostics/idl (XAML diagnostics' IDL), and the
sources roadmap step 32.3 builds so far with the headers they include: the
XAML core's lowest component libraries (dxaml/xcp/components: base,
xstring, criticalsection, dependencyLocator, runtimeEnabledFeatures, com,
threading, staticpal, qualifiers; the type metadata, metadata and
metadata/DynamicMetadataStorage;
CDependencyObject's property system, DependencyObject and its minimal
DependencyObject/minlib; the value types CValue, flyweight,
primitiveDependencyObjects, math and theming; the collections, Collection;
with their MSBuild projects; the resources, deferral, legacy, colors and
winuri components and the markup parser, core/Parser, with the .props
files its sources.props imports; the parser's object writer runtime,
core/Parser/runtime, and the core's resource dictionary,
core/core/elements' Resources.cpp with the other sources of
elements.except.vcxproj and its sources.props, and DeferredKeys.cpp; the
simple properties and name scopes, components/simple and
components/namescope), pal/common's ctypes.cpp and matrix.cpp (the
math library's geometry helpers) and MemoryStream, MemoryStreamBuffer,
refcounting, MsResourceHelpers and UriXStringGetters (the parser's and
WinURI's), core/dll/services.cpp, the isolated unit tests' stubs and
metadata mocks (components/unittests/stubs, less seven stubs NovaOS does
not link, and components/metadata/mocks; xaml_teststubs.lib, linked by
xamlbasetest), the isolated parser unit tests' mock core services
(components/parser/unittests, linked by xamlparsetest, with
dxaml/test/native/inc/XamlLogging.h), the components'
precompiled header (components/pch), headers from dxaml/xcp/inc, core/inc,
pal and the components' inc directories those include, the core services
(core/dll/xcpcore.cpp and xcpcore_namescope.cpp, with core/xcpcore.vcxproj,
core/hw's MaxTextureSizeProvider.cpp and AtlasRequestProvider.cpp, and the
headers they include), what CCoreServices::Create makes (core/dll's
rendertargetbitmapmgr.cpp, core/dethunk/elements/MediaQueue.cpp,
core/text/common/TextCore.cpp, core/native/text/Common/WinTextCore.cpp with
its project and precompiled header, core/core/elements/geometry.cpp with
the elements' lib/elements.vcxproj, components/theminginterop), the
platform layer (plat/win/browserdesktop's xcpwin.cpp, PlatformServices.cpp,
WinThreadPool.cpp and early_init.cpp, with its project, sources.props and
precompiled header), the framework's entry points (dxaml/lib's
DXamlCore.cpp, DXamlInstanceStorage.cpp, DXamlServices.cpp,
comTemplateLibrary.cpp, XamlReader.cpp and FrameworkApplication_Partial.cpp,
winrtgeneratedclasses' XamlReader.g.cpp and FrameworkApplication.g.cpp, with
lib/sources.props, lib/precomp.h and winrtfoundation/wrtdxamlfoundation.vcxproj)
and the headers those include, external/inc's gsl
and ankerl, and XAML's ETW manifest
(dxaml/xcp/plat/win/desktop/Microsoft-Windows-XAML-ETW.man).  The rest of
dxaml (the rest of the core and the controls) joins as
the build takes it in (docs/design/windows-ui-xaml.md).

tools/winrt/abigen.py turns the IDL into the C++ ABI headers MIDL would
make (MIDL is not used).  Features FeatureFlags.h marks AlwaysDisabled are
left out, as MIDL leaves them out of the public metadata; Feature_HeaderPlacement
is left out too, so the result matches the published Microsoft.UI.Xaml.winmd.

To update: copy the same files from a newer commit, run
python3 tools/winrt/abigen.py --check, and build (userland/windows_ui_xaml/
build.py compiles the components; a source a newer commit adds to their
projects, or a header it newly includes, has to be copied too).
